parameters.jsCode:
// GROUP 5 — BUILD THE IMMUTABLE AUDIT RECORD
// Every field required by the thesis human-review specification.

return $input.all().map((item) => {
  const r = item.json;
  return {
    json: {
      audit_record: {
        request_id: r.request_id,
        engine_id: r.unit_number,
        time_in_cycles: r.time_in_cycles,
        timestamp_utc: r.created_at_utc,
        reviewed_at_utc: r.reviewed_at_utc ?? null,

        point_prediction_cycles: r.point_rul,
        interval_lower_cycles: r.lower_bound,
        interval_upper_cycles: r.upper_bound,
        interval_width_cycles: r.interval_width,
        interval_status: r.interval_status,
        confidence_level: r.confidence_level,

        risk_category: r.priority,
        uncertainty_flag: r.uncertainty_flag,
        top_explanation_drivers: r.top_drivers,
        explanation_status: r.explanation_status,

        automatically_proposed_action: r.proposed_action,
        decision_reasons: r.decision_reasons,
        review_route: r.review_route,
        reviewer_identity: r.reviewer_identity,
        reviewer_decision: r.reviewer_decision,
        reviewer_reason: r.reviewer_reason,
        final_approved_action: r.final_approved_action,
        human_reviewed: r.human_reviewed,
        review_is_simulated: true,

        data_quality_status: r.data_quality_status,
        data_quality_issues: r.data_quality_issues,

        model_name: r.model_name,
        model_sha256: r.model_sha256,
        rule_policy_version: r.policy_version,
        rule_policy_approval_status: r.policy_approval_status,
        service_version: r.service_version,
        workflow_version: r.workflow_version,
        service_error: r.service_error ?? null
      }
    }
  };
});
